notes: Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Utility PvE-Minor PvE-Champion PvE-GroupAdd PvE-EndGame PvE-God M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for both dealing with Unstoppable Champions and clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal, Hard or Very Hard difficulty. Pluperfect is a high-impact auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "range outlier with good stagger access, 2nd best damage profile despite low fire rate". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Unstoppable, and ×0.8 accuracy cone size and ×0.83 accuracy cone growth when moving 2.8m/s or less (crouch walking speed) as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is left of vertical and tight so you could take the Recoil Direction to 100 with the barrel perk or look to boost Stability to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks - particularly High-Caliber Rounds - work well for this roll, or perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed are the best alternatives. This roll maximises stagger, as well as stunning Unstoppable Champions. For this, in the first trait perk column, Stopping Power provides increased stagger, and increased damage on low health enemies - ×1.07 when health is below 34%, ×1.1 when <23% and ×1.15 when <18%. In the second column, Kinetic Tremors emits three 6m AoE Kinetic shockwaves after 11 hits within 3s of each other, which are treated as weapon damage so inherit damage boosts. Aegis ranks the Fail Deadly origin trait as A-Tier for PvE, granting a stack per damage tick up to the base magazine size - at max stacks a reload provides ×2 magazine size, which stacks with other mag size buffs like Overflow, as well as boosting Range by +15 and Aim Assist by +5. If you're interested, the name originates from the Latin phrase "plus quam perfectum", which translates literally to "more than perfect". Pluperfect is also a verb tense (also known as the past perfect), describing an action that was completed before another event in the past, such as "By the time we landed for the Taniks checkpoint, Adams had already equipped Divinity". Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.
